mission: Audit profond multi-caissier concurrent operations (6 scenarios)
overall_verdict: GREEN (1 caveat: rate-limit mechanism source-verified but env override prevents empirical trigger)

tests.title: Same item, two cashier carts — shared cart impossible

findings.pos_cart_persistence_model: Client-side only (Vue store / Vanilla wizard buffer). No server-side shared cart record between two cashier sessions.
findings.only_pos_persistence_is_pos_parked_order: user-scoped via index pos_parked_user_idem_uniq (user_id + idempotency_token UNIQUE) + listForOperator filter user_id=
findings.stock_decrement_trigger: Per-Order (AvailabilityService listens on OrderCreated/OrderCanceled/RefundCreated). No stock_movements rows pre-encaisser.

tests.conclusion: There is NO shared-cart construct. Two cashiers building independent carts produce two independent orders at encaisser-time. Stock decrement is per-order, gated by lockForUpdate on stock_levels — concurrent decrements serialize. (Quantitative 1-vs-2 outcome is owned by DEEP-RUPTURE-CYCLE.)
tests.verdict: PASS — isolation by absence: no shared cart entity exists to leak between sessions.

tests.title: Cashier A parked order pris par Cashier B ?

service_layer_probe.result_summary: A parks → B listForOperator(uid=19, branch=1) returns 0 tickets; B recall(parkedId) returns null; A listForOperator returns 1 ticket.

race_protections: PosParkedOrderService::listForOperator filters where user_id = uid AND branch_id = bid (app/Services/PosParkedOrderService.php:62-70)
PosParkedOrderService::recall / discard filter user_id + branch_id + lockForUpdate (lines 72-103, 195-202)
ParkedOrderController::resolveOperatorContext enforces (authId === requestUserId) AND branch_id > 0 (app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Pos/ParkedOrderController.php:72-101) — P0-POS-04 GOAL round-2 fix
tests.verdict: PASS — strict user_id + branch_id filter, B cannot see/recall/delete A's parked ticket. S2-P3 finding confirmed (PosParkedOrder filter user_id strict).

response_body.message: Commande déjà encaissée par un autre caissier.

cases: service throws typed exception when different cashier races
service same cashier replay returns no op not exception

race_protections: K2-HEAL-01 dual-arm guard: same-cashier replay no-op + different-cashier 409 (app/Services/PaymentService.php:227-310)

tests.verdict: PASS — 409 race response identical to sentinel contract; data integrity bit-perfect.

tests.title: Same cashier double-click idempotent (V5.5 sister guard)

runs.outcome: middleware replay — Idempotency-Replayed: true header present
V5.5 service-layer sister guard — same-cashier no-op

race_protections: Layer 1 — IdempotencyKeyMiddleware SET-NX-EX with scoped key idempotency:v1:branch:user:hash(key) (app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:84-156). Replay returns cached 2xx body + Idempotency-Replayed: true header.
Layer 2 — V5.5 service-layer sister guard in PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment (lines 278-298): if order already PAID AND currentUserId === collectorAudit.user_id → no-op return without throw.
tests.verdict: PASS — middleware dedup + service sister guard double-defense, NO double cash_movement, NO double fiscal_seq.

tests.title: Cashier session pendant admin force-logout

steps.action: Admin/tinker: User::find(19)->tokens()->delete() — all Cashier B Sanctum tokens nuked
Cashier B retries SAME GET with stale bearer

graceful_handling.front_end_pattern: Frontend axios interceptor handles 401 → redirect to /login (verified pattern across codebase)

tests.admin_force_logout_path: No dedicated admin endpoint — token revocation happens via (a) self-logout, (b) login (which deletes stale tokens for that user, see app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php), (c) password reset, (d) artisan/tinker direct ->tokens()->delete(). For owner-grade force-logout, owner has tinker access.
tests.verdict: PASS — Sanctum token revocation propagates immediately; cashier B next API call returns clean 401 JSON; no leak.

tests.title: Cashier rapid action storm (50+ calls)

test_6b_50_calls_DIFFERENT_idem_keys.histogram: 50 × status=200 (all V5.5 service sister-guard no-op replies — same cashier already collected)

test_6c_150_calls_GET_pending_endpoint.throttle_observation: Throttle DID NOT trigger because dev env override pos.rate_limit.order_update=1000 (prod default 120/min)

tests.rate_limiter_mechanism_present: RouteServiceProvider.php:165-168 — RateLimiter::for('pos-order-update') → Limit::perMinute(config('pos.rate_limit.order_update', 120))->by(user_id|ip). Attached to all counter-collect routes via throttle:pos-order-update middleware.
tests.caveat: Rate limit MECHANISM verified by source read + config introspection (config('pos.rate_limit.order_update') resolves to 1000 in this dev env). EMPIRICAL 429 NOT OBSERVED because dev env raises the ceiling. Production default is 120/min — would trigger at call 121 under same hammer.
race_protections: Layer 3 — V5.5 service-layer sister guard inside PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment
tests.verdict: PASS — 100 storm calls produced exactly 1 fiscal_seq, 1 tx, 1 audit. Idempotency cache + sister guard absorbed every duplicate. Rate-limiter caveat: mechanism present, prod ceiling not empirically tripped because dev env override.

race_protections_verified.evidence: Source verify + config introspection (dev override pos.rate_limit.order_update=1000)

race_protections_verified.evidence: Test 3 — cashier A reread post-lock sees PAID flag, branches to K2-HEAL-01

parked_orders.state: Still owned by cashier A (Test 2 final state)

seeded_data_residue.tokens_state: User 17 + 19 tokens active (refreshed for Test 2 HTTP probe; not revoked at end)
seeded_data_residue.cleanup_note: Residue matches existing soak/stress data pattern; non-blocking. Owner can purge via PosPurgeParkedOrders + manual order soft-delete if desired.

final_verdict: GREEN — multi-cashier isolation, race protection, and idempotency layered defenses all verified empirically + via passing sentinel. One honest caveat: rate-limit empirical trigger blocked by env override (mechanism present, prod default 120/min unproven in live test).
